title: Attendance: in-app notification on 3 consecutive absences

requirements.summary: Show an in-app notification on the Attendance screen when a member reaches 3 consecutive absences in the current section after saving an attendance record.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user creates or updates an attendance record in AttendancePage, the app evaluates consecutive absences per member using the section’s saved attendance records sorted by date ascending (oldest -> newest).

If a member is marked Absent in the last 3 consecutive attendance records for that section, an in-app notification (e.g., a toast/alert) is displayed containing the exact template text with <member name> replaced by the member’s full name.

If multiple members satisfy the condition after save, the app shows a notification for each affected member (or a single notification that clearly lists each affected member with the template text), without crashing.
No notification is shown for members who have fewer than 3 consecutive absences, or whose absence streak is broken by a Present entry in between.
The detection is scoped to the currently selected section (no cross-section data is considered).

file_operations.description: Add a small utility that, given the current section’s attendance records and members, sorts records by date ascending (oldest -> newest), computes each member’s last-3 statuses, and returns the list of members (with fullName) who are Absent in the last 3 consecutive records.

After a successful create/update in handleSubmit, re-evaluate consecutive absences using the section’s attendance records in chronological order (including the just-saved record by merging it into the in-memory list), and display an in-app toast notification (via the existing sonner toast usage) for each affected member using the exact template: "Deraina Jesosy, mila mamangy an'i <member name> ianareo Komity. Mifalia ao amin'ny Tompo." scoped to currentSection only.
